ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a circle, G is at the very top of the circle, J is at the very bottom of the circle, and the two are connected by a vertical line segment, representing diameter GJ. H is on the right side of the circle, and JH and GH are both chords inside the circle; angle 3 is marked at point J, located between chord JG and JH. Reasoning: The problem gives m\widehat{JH}=114°. Because GJ is a diameter, the measure of the right semicircular arc from G to J passing through H is 180°. This semicircular arc is composed of arc GH and arc JH, so m\widehat{GH}=180°-114°=66°. Angle 3 is an inscribed angle, and its intercepted arc is GH, so m∠3=\frac{1}{2}\cdot 66°=33°.
